Obsessed with this sentiment on friendship

*[Article card (preview; full article not acquired)](<https://sofset.substack.com/p/nice-people-make-bad-friends>)*

Nice People Make Bad Friends — SOFSET

*Selected article excerpt (not full article), by SOFSET:*

> If I buy you a $5 coffee, I am not asking you to Venmo me. You’ll get the next one. Or you won’t. Maybe I’ll buy ten coffees and thirty years from now you’ll be helping me move the Hamptons house into an offshore holding company before my ex-husband realizes what’s happening. Who cares?

*[Substack Note source](<https://substack.com/@oatmilkallison/note/c-337896966>) · Sep 15, 2026, 6:50 PM*
